notes.title: Weekend update
notes.content:
Good evening all,
As per a user request the multiple choice section has been modified to select neighboring countries if available rather than randomly chosen from around the world. This should make things a little more challenging for the multiple choice mode.
Scrolling and zooming blocks have been removed so the globe can be scanned with mouse at will.
You can also make the globe set upright by right clicking on it.

Enjoy!
